entries.detail: Initial modal cancel focus and invalid publication classification defects corrected; initial browser run later stopped after no progress. Stall root cause unconfirmed. Owned process/port cleanup recorded; later focused and complete runs pass.

Node route.fetch did not consult the existing Windows trusted certificate. Child-only NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca corrected request-client trust without weakening browser TLS or changing trust stores.

All Sessions stages reached the final ordinary verification assertion. Unscoped status locator matched both fixture Ready and dialog status. One-line fixture-status selector correction committed370c309.
Sandbox could not see CurrentUser certificate store; same strict-TLS test using normal authorized user access passed. No certificate-store mutation.

Running local app held build DLLs. Verified only that app's PID/start time/assembly/config before stopping it; rebuilt0warnings/errors and restarted app-only. No Docker services, data or certificate changes.

final_results: Canonical qualification-binding.json retains each passing invocation at its actual source. Earlier failures are not relabelled PASS.
